headline: KOSPI hits top of trading range… breakthrough via semiconductors? Or adjustment due to high interest rates?
summary: The KOSPI has surpassed 7,000 and reached the upper end of its trading range. Analysts question whether semiconductors will drive a breakout or high interest rates will trigger an adjustment.
why: The KOSPI is South Korea's main equity benchmark, and semiconductors carry a large weight in it, making chip demand and interest-rate expectations key drivers.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The index is at the top of its trading range, with direction depending on semiconductors and interest rates.
